name: GB energy supply margins
summary: NESO expects adequate electricity margins this winter; no notices issued
state: NESO's winter outlook expects adequate GB electricity margins, which it called the strongest in six years, though some analysts see a lower buffer (NESO; Drax). No Electricity Margin Notice, capacity market notice or Gas Margins Notice had been issued as of 5 Nov.
for_you: No action needed; NESO publishes notices if margins tighten.
rubric_hit: No NESO or National Gas notices = Normal
basis_detail: NESO and National Gas system notices
basis_by: NESO and National Gas system notices

sources.title: NESO — Strongest winter electricity margins in six years
Drax — NESO forecasts adequate but lower supply margins this winter

why: When gas or electricity margins tighten, Britain risks price spikes and, at worst, controlled disconnections in winter.
drivers: Gas imports and storage, wind output, interconnectors, plant outages, cold weather.

rubric.alert: A Gas Deficit Warning, a high risk of demand control notice, or demand control used.
rubric.watch: NESO issues an Electricity Margin Notice or capacity market notice, or National Gas issues a Gas Margins Notice.
rubric.normal: NESO and National Gas report adequate margins; no notices issued.
